newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Marco Polo launches last Ardmore block.
newsitem.headline: Marco Polo launches last Ardmore block.

text.p: Marco Polo Developments Ltd said on Friday its subsidiary MP-Bilt Pte Ltd would launch the third and final block of its upmarket private residential property, Ardmore Park, on November 9.
MP-Bilt Pte Ltd started a soft launch of the 330-unit Ardmore Park, located in the island-state's prestigious Orchard Road area, on June 24.

Prices of the 2,885 square foot apartments started at Singapore $4.65 million and went up to S$5.99 million. It also has six 8,740 square foot penthouses which cost S$13.88 million -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
